scientific.integrity: The proof is an exact reversible reduction of the published equations. Completeness follows from a factored quadratic in one positive variable; the symbolic script only replays identities and an exact counterexample.
scientific.limitations: The classification is for the order-two translation-invariant source system on the boundary \(b=1\). It does not classify \(b\ne1\), periodic or non-translation-invariant states, or re-audit unrelated formulas in the source. The ordinary nearest-neighbor Ising phase threshold is classical and is not claimed as new.

title: The missing \(mt=1\) branch in the order-two Ising–Vannimenus boundary-law system
